messages:
nora: Quick weekly health check for Beacon Health — heads up on model-mix drift after last night's rollout. TL;DR: new model `redwood-neo-v2` uptake fell from ~38% -> ~12% in last 24h, fallback rate up 0.8% -> 4.7%, p95 latency increased 220ms -> 340ms, spend +18% due to retries.
cs-bot: Metrics snapshot (24h): tokens=1.12M, requests=48.3k, neo-v2 uptake=12%, fallback_count=2,267, fallback_rate=4.7%, p95_latency=340ms, errors(503)=132, avg_retry_count=1.3
samir: Noted. I saw a sharp routing weight change at ~03:15 UTC — canary was ramped to 50% for midnight canary. That explains the sudden upstream pressure. Suggest revert canary to 20% and pause further ramps for 24h. :thinking_face:
lia: I'll prep a short note for Beacon's onboarding team explaining what happened and next steps. Also propose a 30-min sync with them to walk the fallback telemetry and how to interpret our Dashboard. Wed 14:00 PST works?
chen: From the runtime logs: several GPUs showed KV cache miss storms and one node logged transient OOMs around the same window. When the canary weight spiked, neo-v2 increased average sequence length and triggered more cache churn.
chen: Recommend temporary mitigation: pin requests to the quantized variant `neo-v2-q4` for canary traffic, and add prefix caching for frequent prompts. Also raising `max_inflight_per_model` helped in our internal repro. Sample canary patch:
chen: ```json
{
  "routing": { "neo-v2": 0.2, "neo-v2-q4": 0.3, "fallback": 0.5 },
  "runtime_flags": { "enable_prefix_cache": true, "max_sequence": 1024 }
}
```
samir: Good call. I'll schedule the weight revert now and deploy the routing patch to canary only. Will monitor fallback_rate and p95 for the next 3 hours and report back.
nora: Actions: (1) Samir — revert to 20% and monitor (2) Chen — apply quantized pin + prefix cache in canary (3) Lia — schedule Beacon sync Wed 14:00 PST and send a short incident note. I'll update the account health dashboard and mark renewal risk as "low" but conditional until fallback <1% for 48h. :thumbsup:
lia: Sending invite now. I'll include a quick one-pager on "how to read fallback alerts" and include a short checklist for their SREs.
samir: Patch deployed to canary at 1874312600. Initial 30m shows fallback down to 2.1%, p95 to 290ms. Continuing to watch.
cs-bot: Automated update: fallback_rate=2.1% at snapshot t+30m, p95=290ms, errors(503)=34, retry_count avg=1.05.
nora: Thanks team. We'll reconvene in this thread after 24h and before Beacon sync. If numbers don't continue trending down, we'll open a post-mortem and consider rolling back fully.
